pairs: and I lifted up my eyes
et ecce quatuor quadrigæ egredientes de medio duorum montium:
four four-horse chariots went out from the middle of two mountains.
And the mountains were mountains of brass.
In the first chariot were red horses,
et in quadriga secunda equi nigri,
and in the second chariot were black horses,
et in quadriga tertia equi albi,
and in the third chariot were white horses,
et in quadriga quarta equi varii
and in the fourth chariot were speckled horses,
et dixi ad angelum qui loquebatur in me:
and said to the angel who was speaking with me,
“These are the four winds of heaven,
qui egrediuntur ut stent coram Dominatore omnis terræ.
which go forth to stand in the presence of the Sovereign of all the earth.”
In qua erant equi nigri, egrediebantur in terram aquilonis:
The one with the black horses was departing into the land of the North,
et albi egressi sunt post eos,
and the white went forth after them,
et varii egressi sunt ad terram austri.
and the speckled went forth towards the land of the South.
Yet those who were the most strong,
et quærebant ire et discurrere per omnem terram.
and sought to go and to roam quickly through all the earth.
And they walked throughout the earth.
And he called me and spoke with me,
Ecce qui egrediuntur in terram aquilonis,
those who go forth to the land of the North,
requiescere fecerunt spiritum meum in terra aquilonis.
have quieted my spirit in the land of the North.”
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
et venies tu in die illa,
You will approach in that day,
et intrabis domum Josiæ filii Sophoniæ,
and you will go into the house of Josiah,
the son of Zephaniah, who came from Babylon.
And you will take gold and silver;
et pones in capite Jesu filii Josedec,
and you will set them on the head of Jesus the son of Jehozadak,
And you will speak to him,
Thus says the Lord of hosts,
And under him, he will rise up,
and he will build a temple to the Lord.
And he will raise a temple to the Lord.
And he will carry the glory,
et erit sacerdos super solio suo,
And he will be a priest upon his throne,
et consilium pacis erit inter illos duos.
and a counsel of peace will be between the two of them.
And the crowns will be to Heldai,
as well as to Hem, the son of Zephaniah,
as a memorial in the temple of the Lord.
And those who are far away,
and will build in the temple of the Lord.
et scietis quia Dominus exercituum misit me ad vos. Erit autem hoc,
And you will know that the Lord of hosts sent me to you. Yet this shall be only if,
si auditu audieritis vocem Domini Dei vestri.
when hearing, you will have heeded the voice of the Lord your God.
